title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يلتقي في القاهرة بشيخ الأزهر الشريف
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew Meets the Shaykh of al-Azhar in Cairo
body_ar:
يقوم فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بزيارة لجمهورية مصر أدى خلالها اليوم الأحد 16 محرم 1433 الموافق: 11/12/2011 زيارة تعاون وأخوة لمقر الأزهر الشريف بالعاصمة المصرية القاهرة، حيث استقبل فضيلته من طرف سماحة الدكتور أحمد الطيب شيخ الأزهر الشريف بمقر مشيخة الأزهر، بحضور فضيلة الدكتور صفوت حجازي الأمين العام لرابطة علماء أهل السنة.

وخلال اللقاء تحدث فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو عن تجربة مركز تكوين العلماء والدور العلمي الذي يضطلع به لتكوين علماء يجمعون بين موسوعية خريجي المحاظر وتخصص المتخرجين وفق المناهج المعاصرة، وتطرق الشيخ باسمه رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين للحديث عن هذه الجامعة الحديثة، مؤكدا على أنها تعمل من أجل توفير مناخ أكاديمي يغطي عددا من التخصصات الهامة والمتنوعة، وفق منظومة تعليمية متكاملة.

وقد رحب سماحة شيخ الأزهر بهذا النشاط العلمي الهادف إلى إشاعة العلم الشرعي على مذهب أهل السنة والجماعة، والذي ظل يميز بلاد شنقيط الواقعة في أقصى الغرب الإسلامى، وأكد فضيلته على استعداد الأزهر للتعاون العلمي مع مؤسستي مركز تكوين العلماء وجامعة عبد الله بن ياسين بنواكشوط ونظائرهما في موريتانيا وغيرها من دول الغرب الإسلامي الشقيق.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, is making a visit to the Republic of Egypt, in the course of which he paid today, Sunday 16 Muharram 1433, corresponding to 11/12/2011, a visit of cooperation and brotherhood to the seat of al-Azhar in the Egyptian capital, Cairo, where His Eminence was received by His Eminence Dr Ahmad al-Tayyib, Shaykh of al-Azhar, at the headquarters of the Mashyakhah of al-Azhar, in the presence of His Eminence Dr Safwat Hijazi, secretary general of the League of Scholars of the People of the Sunnah.

During the meeting His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew spoke about the experience of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and the scholarly role it undertakes in forming scholars who combine the encyclopaedic breadth of the graduates of the maḥāẓir with the specialisation of those who graduate under contemporary curricula. The Sheikh went on, in his name as president of the ʿAbd Allah ibn Yasin University, to speak about that new university, affirming that it works to provide an academic environment covering a number of important and varied specialisms, within an integrated educational system.

His Eminence the Shaykh of al-Azhar welcomed this scholarly activity, aimed at spreading the knowledge of the Sharia according to the school of the People of the Sunnah and the Community, which has continued to distinguish the land of Shinqit, situated in the far west of the Islamic world. His Eminence affirmed al-Azhar's readiness for scholarly cooperation with the two institutions — the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and the ʿAbd Allah ibn Yasin University in Nouakchott — and with their counterparts in Mauritania and in the other countries of the brotherly Islamic west.

flags.arabic: وتطرق الشيخ باسمه رئيس جامعة عبد الله بن ياسين للحديث
flags.context: the Sheikh's second capacity at the meeting
options: render literally ('in his name as president'), as done here
read as بصفته ('in his capacity as') and render accordingly
flags.note: باسمه does not construe here; the phrase the sense requires is بصفته, 'in his capacity as'. The literal rendering is kept so that the oddity is visible in the English rather than smoothed away, per style guide section 11. Either reading gives the same substantive fact — that he holds the presidency of the university as well as of the Centre — so nothing material turns on it.

flags.context: what the Centre's graduates are meant to combine
options: the encyclopaedic breadth of the graduates of the maḥāẓir
the breadth of the mahdara graduates
the polymathy of the traditional seminarians
flags.note: المحاظر is the plural of محظرة, the same institution as in records 756 and 768 in this span, and the corpus needs one fixed rendering for both singular and plural, decided centrally. موسوعية is the quality of covering the whole field rather than a specialism, which is exactly the contrast the sentence draws; 'encyclopaedic breadth' keeps the contrast, 'polymathy' shifts it onto the person.

flags.arabic: بحضور فضيلة الدكتور صفوت حجازي الأمين العام لرابطة علماء أهل السنة
flags.context: the third person present at the meeting
options: name him exactly as the source does, with his stated office
name him with an editorial note
flags.note: The record places a named third party at the meeting and gives the office he then held. The name is reproduced exactly as the source gives it and no characterisation is added, which is the correct treatment. Raised so that a reviewer is aware the record names him: what has happened to this figure in Egypt since 2011 is a matter of public record and may bear on how the record reads in English fifteen years on, though nothing in the record itself says anything about him beyond his presence and his title.

flags.context: the closing phrase of the record
options: the countries of the brotherly Islamic west
the sister countries of the Islamic Maghreb
the fraternal states of the Islamic west
flags.note: الغرب الإسلامي is the classical designation for the Maghreb and the lands beyond it, and the record has already used بلاد شنقيط … في أقصى الغرب الإسلامي in the same sentence, so the two should agree in the English. الشقيق is the standard diplomatic epithet between Arab states and is kept rather than dropped, since dropping it would lose the register of the sentence.

translator_notes: A short news report of an official visit. Nothing in it is quoted, no ruling is stated, and the five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged.

The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. Here the two hijri and Gregorian dates in the body agree with each other and with the timestamp — 16 Muharram 1433 was indeed Sunday 11 December 2011 — which is unusual in this span and worth noting.

مذهب أهل السنة والجماعة is rendered 'the school of the People of the Sunnah and the Community'. مذهب here is not one of the four legal schools but the broader Sunni position, and the English should not be allowed to suggest a madhhab in the narrow sense.

مشيخة الأزهر is kept as 'the Mashyakhah of al-Azhar' — the office of the Shaykh of al-Azhar — rather than translated, since 'the Sheikhdom of al-Azhar' would mislead and 'the office of the Shaykh of al-Azhar' is already used in the same sentence for the person.
